description: The Universidad Nacional de Chimborazo study team publishes an Excel workbook supporting proposed pavement-condition deduction curves for Ecuador. The free Zenodo file is licensed CC BY 4.0. The primary article explicitly identifies this deposit and explains the twenty-percent adjustment applied to conventional curves using fifteen road sections in Chimborazo. These numerical values can serve as a comparison case for maintenance and condition-state simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook. Coverage is a small local calibration study, not a validated national pavement standard. The article’s public peer reviews disagree, including concerns about the serviceability metric, uniform adjustment and missing reproduction detail. Those limitations must remain attached to any reuse. Deposit 17290621 contains the same workbook checksum plus figures and is treated as a companion mirror. No workbook was downloaded, fitted curve checked or maintenance benefit established.
